Game Overview

In Metal Hero Adventure, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling journey in Metal Hero Adventure, battling alien invaders across 10 action-packed levels. Master the art of shooting and slashing while collecting gems and freeing prisoners. With intuitive controls and engaging mechanics, it’s a captivating quest for heroes of all ages, playable anywhere.
